propositions: LLM step failures that do not abort a run are invisible in the plan-review verdict JSON because swallow sites log warnings only and the verdict has no counter for survived failures.
An empty overlap[] array cannot be distinguished from one emptied by repeated judge failures, making silent degradation invisible to callers consuming the gate's JSON.

A run-scoped contextvars sink in step_failures.py records non-fatal LLM step failures at the single runner seam (runner.py:573) and drains them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation safety for clean runs.
The llm_step_failures counter is shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<call_label>: <int>}} and keyed by _call_label verbatim so operators can grep logs and match the verdict tally.
The plan-review text output renderer (_render_plan_review_text) prints a single line naming total and per-step failure counts when the key is present and nothing when absent.
